# Necto

> Necto automates finance recruiting outreach for students. It finds contacts at investment banks, private equity firms, and venture capital firms, then generates personalized cold emails and tracks replies.

## Product
- [Home](https://usenecto.com): Main landing page and waitlist signup

## About
Necto is a waitlist-stage SaaS tool for finance students at target schools (Wharton, Stern, Ross, Georgetown, Notre Dame) recruiting for investment banking, private equity, venture capital, and asset management roles. Covers 200+ firms. Built to reduce recruiting outreach time by 95%.
